svg.title: One Terraform module for every region
svg.desc: The per-region SFU resources (EC2, Transcribe) are one Terraform module. Each region only adds a config file, region-1.conf to region-N.conf, which feeds the module; the module deploys Region 1 to N. The Admin Region's services have their own code, and everything is deployed in one run, so adding or removing a region is a config change.
